text: Some of the most sensitive Form PF disclosures are not readily obtainable by the funds themselves: counterparty credit exposure often cannot be determined by individual fund managers, which makes the reporting requirement burdensome in practice.
citation: Kaal and Oesterle, The History of Hedge Fund Regulation in the United States (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2714974

isBasedOn.name: The History of Hedge Fund Regulation in the United States

abstract: For example, the disclosure of counterparty credit exposure is sensitive information that often cannot readily be determined by the individual fund managers.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to Form PF counterparty credit exposure reporting
